description: Dark and light themes: Aura, Aqua, Lime, and Azure, plus Aqua Lime Light with brighter summer syntax. An independent fork of Aura by Dalton Menezes.

aura.experimental.gradients.markdownDescription: Enable experimental mint/cyan button gradients, cyan-to-green numeric activity badges, and shared focus rings on inputs, primary buttons, toolbar icons and notification cards in Aqua Light and Aqua Lime Light. Requires **Custom CSS and JS Loader** (be5invis.vscode-custom-css), which modifies your local VS Code installation. Use **Aura: Apply Gradient Setting** and reload after changing this setting or updating Aura. Updates to VS Code can require reapplying. Desktop only; styles affect matching themes in all windows of this installation.
